# Pokémon Random

> Pokémon Random is a free, fan-made collection of Pokémon tools and a complete reference database. We offer 12 interactive tools including a random Pokémon generator, team builder, type wheel spinner, guessing game, advanced randomizer with filters, comparison tool, type chart, shiny checker, starter picker, search, tier list builder, and saved teams manager. Our database covers all 1,025 Pokémon from Generation 1 (Kanto) through Generation 9 (Paldea), with dedicated pages for each Pokémon, move, ability, type, and generation. All tools are free to use and require no signup or registration.

## Site Information

- Title: Pokémon Random — Free Generator, Team Builder & Pokédex
- Description: Free Pokémon tools: random generator, team builder, shiny checker, type chart, quiz, and complete Pokédex with all 1,025 Pokémon. No signup required.
- URL: https://pokemonrandom.com
- Author: Pokémon Random Team
- Language: English
- Last updated: 2026
- Data source: Official PokéAPI (https://pokeapi.co)
- License: Fan-made tool, not affiliated with Nintendo, Game Freak, or The Pokémon Company

## Main Tools

- [Random Pokémon Generator](https://pokemonrandom.com/random-pokemon/): Generate a random Pokémon from all 1,025 in the National Pokédex. Filter by generation, view stats, types, abilities, cries, and shiny forms.
- [Random Team Builder](https://pokemonrandom.com/random-team/): Build a balanced team of 6 random Pokémon. Perfect for Nuzlocke challenges and casual playthroughs.
- [Pokémon Quiz](https://pokemonrandom.com/pokemon-quiz/): Guess That Pokémon game — identify Pokémon from silhouettes, earn points, and build streaks.
- [Type Wheel Spinner](https://pokemonrandom.com/type-wheel/): Spin the wheel to get a random Pokémon type. Great for monotype challenges and type-themed runs.
- [Pokémon Randomizer](https://pokemonrandom.com/pokemon-randomizer/): Advanced randomizer with filters for generation, type, and legendary status. Ideal for Nuzlocke and monotype runs.
- [Pokémon Comparison Tool](https://pokemonrandom.com/pokemon-compare/): Compare two Pokémon side by side. See which has better stats, types, and abilities.
- [Random Starter Pokémon Picker](https://pokemonrandom.com/random-starter/): Randomly pick a starter Pokémon from Gen 1 to Gen 9.
- [Shiny Pokémon Checker](https://pokemonrandom.com/shiny-pokemon/): Browse all shiny Pokémon forms across all 9 generations.
- [Pokémon Search](https://pokemonrandom.com/pokemon-search/): Find any Pokémon by name or National Pokédex number.
- [Pokémon Tier List Builder](https://pokemonrandom.com/tier-lists/): Create custom tier lists by ranking Pokémon from best to worst.
- [Saved Teams Manager](https://pokemonrandom.com/saved-teams/): Save and manage your Pokémon teams for easy access.
- [Pokémon of the Day](https://pokemonrandom.com/pokemon-of-the-day/): Discover a new Pokémon every day with detailed stats and information.

## Database Pages

- [Complete Pokédex](https://pokemonrandom.com/pokemon/): All 1,025 Pokémon with detailed pages including base stats, types, abilities, evolution chains, and shiny forms.
- [Pokémon Moves Database](https://pokemonrandom.com/moves/): All 920+ moves with type, category (Physical/Special/Status), power, accuracy, and effects.
- [Pokémon Abilities Database](https://pokemonrandom.com/abilities/): All 298+ abilities with descriptions and lists of Pokémon that can have them.
- [Pokémon Type Chart](https://pokemonrandom.com/type-chart/): Full 18×18 type effectiveness matrix showing strengths, weaknesses, and immunities.
- [Generation 1 — Kanto](https://pokemonrandom.com/generation/1/): The original 151 Pokémon from Pokémon Red, Blue, and Green (1996).
- [Generation 4 — Sinnoh](https://pokemonrandom.com/generation/4/): 107 Pokémon from Pokémon Diamond, Pearl, and Platinum.

## Technical Information

- Framework: Next.js (static site generation)
- Hosting: Cloudflare Pages
- Data source: PokéAPI (https://pokeapi.co) — community-maintained open-source API
- No login or signup required for any tool
- No tracking of personal data beyond standard analytics
- Mobile-friendly and responsive design
- All 1,025 Pokémon pages are pre-rendered for instant loading

## Pokémon Data Coverage

- Total Pokémon: 1,025 (Generation 1 through Generation 9)
- Total moves: 920+
- Total abilities: 298+
- Total types: 18 (Normal, Fire, Water, Grass, Electric, Ice, Fighting, Poison, Ground, Flying, Psychic, Bug, Rock, Ghost, Dragon, Dark, Steel, Fairy)
- Generations covered: 9 (Kanto, Johto, Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos, Alola, Galar, Paldea)
